title: Exterior sheaves commute with full-open restriction and pushforward
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $M$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $d\in\mathbf N$. Let $j:X|_X\to X$ be the inclusion of the full-open subscheme into $X$, and let $j^*M$ be the restriction of $M$ to that open subscheme. Writing $\bigwedge^d$ for the sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there is an isomorphism of module sheaves $j_*(\bigwedge^d(j^*M))\cong\bigwedge^d M$. No local freeness hypothesis is imposed on $M$.

proof.text: Use the retained upstream exteriorSheaf_fullOpen_pushforward_iso. Its proof specializes exteriorSheaf_restrict_iso to the full open, uses X.topIso.hom to identify restriction with pullback and inverse pushforward, and composes pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr and pushforwardId. The upstream exteriorPower is the sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers required in the statement; the existing exteriorSheaf_eq_exteriorPower theorem identifies the legacy exteriorSheaf notation with it. These constructions and the restriction theorem impose no freeness, positive-degree or nonempty-scheme hypotheses.
